name: Nereus
lore: Admiral of the submerged Void Fleet who commands pressurized depth currents and an ancestral Hydro-Trident.
appearance: Weathered captain clad in deep navy trench coat with coral-encrusted brass armor and aquamarine eyes.
unique_mechanic: Vortex Drag (Gravitational water current that pulls or pushes opponent) & Tidal Wave projectiles.

home_stage.name: The Sunken Trench of Atlantis
home_stage.setting: Ancient underwater dome sanctuary situated on the abyssal ocean floor.
home_stage.visuals: Greek marble columns, bioluminescent glass dome, sea leviathans gliding in dark ocean.
home_stage.bgm_style: Ambient Techno / Progressive House with smooth synth pads and driving 4-on-the-floor rhythm.
